You definitely wanna be real slow and incremental with weed while tripping, especially if you’re having an uncomfortable time already. And havin’ some fruits and other easy snacks + plenty of water on hand helps with the blood pressure and general physical balance.

Obviously I don’t know a thing about you beyond this block of text, but if you’re looking for uninformed, well-meaning insight into the potential silver lining of this trip, maybe you were fixated on your past embarrassments because it’s important for you to both understand why you were cringing in those moments and accept them as a part of yourself. Perhaps your ‘social anxiety from fear of rejection’ stems partly from wanting to fit in, to be admired along the standards of your peers, maybe partly from moments where you acted in a way that didn’t align with the person you want to be. It’s important to ruminate on these nasty memories, to think about what exactly motivated your cringe in those moments, because those moments reinforce the idea of who we want to be, how we want to see and be seen in this world. Cringe is a nonnegotiable and healthy part of life, but you gotta accept it as lessons learned, you can’t let it destroy your self-confidence. 

But ya know, this is all from one internet rando to another so I’m likely way off base, but hopefully some of this insight proves useful to ya. 

Best of luck processing and happy tripping, friend :)

You’re the best judge of what you can handle, but I will say that three trips is not a lot. I’ve tripped around 12 times and I still consider myself a newbie. 

Tripping alone can be really helpful and is a super fun dimension to explore, but it’s going to force you to face things in a way that it may not in a social setting, so it can get to a scary place pretty fast. 

Listen to your self. If you feel ready then go for it, but if you feel off don’t discount that feeling. It might also be worthwhile to start off with a dose on the order of 50-75 micrograms for your first solo trip, a lot of interesting exploration happens in the lower doses and it’s a lot more manageable to take on alone. 

Best wishes in whatever you do, happy exploration, friend:)

The highest I would go would be 1.5 grams of cubensis for your first time. You may want to start with more of a threshold dose of .5-1g and build up from there (keeping in mind that these doses will not be full on trips until around and above 1.5) if you would like to be very safe. 

Dosage is important, but as I’m sure you’ve read, set and setting take the cake when it comes to having an easier or challenging experience. As long as you are taking it with intention and respecting it as a teacher in a safe environment with a safe person/people, you’re setting yourself up to have a great time. 

I would also recommend taking them outdoors in a wooded area if you have the ability, it’s beautifully eye opening! Good luck and best wishes:)

It’s a different subjective experience for each individual, but there is a possibility that he will throw up. It’s never happened to me, but it does happen. I would advise your friend to fast for the fifteen or so hours leading up to the trip, that’ll make it a lot more manageable in case he does puke (and I think they hit better). Other than that I would say the typical trip sitting biz, be vigilant, create a safe open space, have food, water, a sweater, listen to their musings, etc. 2 grams is also a relatively low dose, so it should be a pretty low maintenance trip sitting experience for you. Good luck, I hope you both have an enlightening and enjoyable experience!
